dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thick white horizontal band visible on the right wing coverts; prominent pale chevron-like markings on the left scapular/tertial region.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.mantle_scapular_texture_pattern: Mantle is 'Uniform/Solid' olive-green; scapulars are 'Scaled/Mottled' with high-contrast pale V-shaped feather fringes.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and distinct pale blue-grey edges along the folded flight feathers, providing high boundary contrast against the dark feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: High-contrast white patch on the posterior neck with an irregular, roughly rectangular shape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct and sharp linear boundary separating the dark crown from the yellowish-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron markings on the left wing surface providing high grayscale contrast against the dark base plumage.
